proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The storm hit Moore a little after six. By the next morning there was a tarp on our back slope. They came back after the adjuster's visit and did the whole roof three weeks later.
reviews.name: Ann W.

reviews.text: Two big pecans hang over our house. After the ice storm they cut the limb off the roof before touching a single shingle, then patched the deck where the branch punched through.
reviews.name: Rick S.

reviews.text: Class 4 roof went on in March. We sent the paperwork to our insurance agent and the premium dropped. Not by a lot, but it drops every year.
reviews.name: Lupe G.

reviews.text: Shay explained what hail actually does to a shingle, let me press a bruise with my own thumb up on the ladder, and didn't push me to sign anything. I called back a week later on my own.
reviews.name: Darnell J.

reviews.text: Wind peeled the ridge cap off the full length of the house. Fixed in an afternoon, and they nailed down two loose tabs over the porch that nobody asked about.
reviews.name: Kayla B.

reviews.text: Metal on our shop and the house. Crew lead walked me along the seams and showed me the clips before they packed up. It sounds great in the rain, honestly.
reviews.name: Frank O.

proof.guarantee: Workmanship covered for 12 years on every full roof we install.
